newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Telefonica to buy govt's TISA stake.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Telefonica to buy govt's TISA stake.

text.p: Spain's telephone provider Telefonica will buy the 23.78 percent stake the government holds in its international arm, Telefonica Internacional (TISA), local media reported.
According to the financial magazine Dinero, this deal, suggested by the current president Juan Villalonga, would give Telefonica 100 percent of the unit.
The total value of TISA is some 810 billion pesetas, with debt of some 200 billion.
TISA's main assets are in Argentina, Peru, Chile, Colombia, Venezuela and Puerto Rico.
In the first quarter of the year, TISA's pre-tax profit rose 27 percent to 5.63 billion pesetas.
